contacts.name: Sparxie
contacts.signature: If the chat gets interrupted, Sparxie will disappear!

150620101.text: [Doomsday Special: Limited-Time Revelry!] Tired of the rubble and the crying? Temporary shelter access (Party Edition) at the "World's End" Tavern is now available! The doomsday fireworks show is about to start, care to grab a drink? Show this code at the door to enjoy chaotic order, bottomless drinks (might be watered down), and a microscopic boost to your survival odds! Special Guests: You and every other unlucky sap in the universe! Spots are limited, so first come, first crazed! Party Organizers: Sparxie, Sampo

150620102.text: Your ultra-exclusive invitation has arrived! Catch!

150620103.text: Is now really the time for this...?

150620104.text: Is now really the time for this...?

150620105.text: What are you scheming this time?

150620107.text: I saw you Nameless and the IPC running around like headless chickens, looking all grim and miserable about saving the world

150620108.text: So Sampo and I wanted to chip in and help

150620109.text: How could the people's idol, Sparxicle, ever abandon her adoring fans?

150620110.text: The closer we get to the end of the world, the more positive we have to be!

150620111.text: Watch closely, Gray Hair, and let Sparxicle show you what highly efficient evacuation looks like!
